summary: Queued the negative half of the parent configuration question, which the account had stated only from source: when the node's snapshot already covers the change, a restart should recover the configuration in force. The probe repeats the remove-and-re-add history but snapshots the node under test after the change and after further traffic, then restarts it. Locally the snapshot carried five servers at index 19 and the recovered configuration matched the configuration in force, so the trigger boundary is confirmed by measurement as well as by the scan arithmetic; that receipt is unread, so the account's source-derived statement of the boundary stands unchanged for now.
